description: Records one character's turn in a scene started by character_meet, exactly as the character returned it. Returns the next speaker and their packet, or the finished scene.

speaker.description: Id of the character whose turn this is.

action.description: Public. What they visibly do: a gesture, a move, helping, blocking, stepping away, touching, striking.

feelings.description: Private. Exactly one entry for every other character still present.

emotion.description: One or two words, mixed if it is mixed: wary, curious, contempt, pity, warmth, shame, desire, rage…

valence.description: -1 … +1: up to -0.8 ready to fight; up to -0.5 hostile, quarrelling; up to -0.2 wary; up to 0.2 neutral; up to 0.5 liking; up to 0.8 close, trusting; up to 1 in love, devoted.

why.description: What in them, or in what the other did, makes them feel this. Point at their own card.

hides.description: Private. What they deliberately don't say.

leaves.description: Public. True if they leave the scene for good.

question_to.description: Public. If their line asks someone a question: that one character's id (an id, not the question). They answer first.

says.description: Public. Their line, in their voice. Omit to stay silent.

thought.description: Private. What goes through their head right now about the situation, in their own inner voice.

to.description: Public. Who the line is addressed to.

urgency.description: How much they want to act next round: 0 content to wait, 1 can't hold back.

wants_to_ask.description: Private. Questions they would like to ask, asked or not.

wants_to_say.description: Private. What they want to say and to whom, said or not.

what.description: What they would like to say.

name: character_meet_turn
title: Record a character's turn (experimental)
